title: SHADOW v2 first-week readiness matrix (v2: expanded with execution, evidence-of-presence and settlement-path dimensions)
method: code paths traced (projector, store, settle_v2, scorecard_v2, board accounting, capture) against the shadow-build standard; a field that exists but is never populated counts as PARTIAL; data captured but not persisted counts as MISSING

requirements.requirement: every NFL market we can see is captured
requirements.evidence_before: registry + provisional list close the gap once merged; 371 contracts in 4 series are NOT_CAPTURED until then; board rows carry no prices
requirements.evidence_after: board rows persisted per snapshot with the capture's bid/ask/mid/volume/liquidity for every NFL contract incl. unsupported (data/shadow/v2/board/); provisional capture unchanged

requirements.requirement: every defensibly modelable market is projected
requirements.evidence_before: 21,299 records per snapshot; every refusal carries a state and reason
requirements.evidence_after: unchanged; flags dict makes HAS_PROBABILITY explicit

requirements.requirement: every projection frozen at T-24 / T-6 / T-90 / T-30
requirements.evidence_before: horizon conductor + markers exist; lateness recorded but never classified; a reused capture snapshot across two horizons is not flagged
requirements.evidence_after: horizon_quality ON_TIME / LATE_ACCEPTABLE / LATE_DEGRADED / MISSED on every record, snapshot_reused flag, target vs observation vs generation timestamps preserved

requirements.requirement: every model arm preserved separately
requirements.evidence_before: one file per arm per snapshot; paired-arm scoring on common contracts
requirements.evidence_after: unchanged; CLV and close pairing keyed by record_id keep arms apart

requirements.requirement: bid / ask / mid captured at the same horizon markers
requirements.evidence_before: record carries yes/no bid/ask, mid (research), width, volume, OI, liquidity, confirmation
requirements.evidence_after: plus market_state (ladder rungs, widths, identification, violations, last trade when the tape has it)

requirements.requirement: exact semantic / identity / support status per contract
requirements.evidence_before: question verbatim, semantic_confidence, identity_confidence, support_state + reason
requirements.evidence_after: plus flags {has_probability, semantics_proven, identity_resolved, settlement_supported, historically_validated, prospectively_validated, execution_supported, betting_authorized}

requirements.requirement: every modelable contract settleable or explicitly non-settleable
requirements.evidence_before: catalog says SUPPORTED / PLANNED / UNSUPPORTED; TEAM_WINS_BY_WEEK, MAKE_PLAYOFFS, DIVISION_WINNER carry probabilities with PLANNED settlement and no automatic matrix
requirements.evidence_after: measured on dispatchability, not on the catalog: all 1,336 SEASON records now carry a derived season (the Kalshi two-digit year cross-checked against the contract's own expiration, refusing if they disagree) and all 1,336 reach the season settlement branch. Replay: SEASON_2025 728 rows, SEASON_2026 608 rows dispatched, 0 silently dropped.

requirements.requirement: every settled projection scored model-vs-market
requirements.evidence_before: scorecard_v2 Brier / log loss / clustered diff vs mid
requirements.evidence_after: scorecard v3 adds close Brier, model-minus-close, CLV blocks

requirements.requirement: every horizon has a closing-line comparison / CLV
requirements.evidence_before: no close selection, no CLV, no pairing anywhere in v2 (the incumbent's pick_close is ledger-only)
requirements.evidence_after: nfl_edge/evaluation/close.py + clv.py; pair_closes_v2.py writes a write-once close + CLV batch per game; CLV_CLOSE_MISSING when no valid pre-kickoff observation

requirements.requirement: every player miss gets an opportunity / efficiency autopsy where possible
requirements.evidence_before: autopsy v2 classifies from feature_lineage; predicted shares only for target/carry stats; no catch-rate / yards-per-target split; no route proxy
requirements.evidence_after: autopsy v3 categories (ROLE, SNAP, ROUTE, TARGET/CARRY share, TEAM_VOLUME, CATCH_RATE, YARDS_PER_TARGET, YARDS_PER_CARRY, TD_VARIANCE, TAIL_SHAPE, MODEL_LOCATION, NORMAL_VARIANCE, INSUFFICIENT_DATA) with predicted and actual components preserved

requirements.requirement: every unsupported market preserved with an explicit reason
requirements.evidence_before: board accounting rows exist only in a research output dir; not published; no prices
requirements.evidence_after: board rows (ticker, family, reason, states, prices) persisted per snapshot on market-data

requirements.requirement: projection records joinable to their close
requirements.evidence_before: record_id + ticker + kickoff_utc exist but no close record or join
requirements.evidence_after: close batches keyed by record_id; research record joins projection, close, settlement, autopsy by record_id

requirements.requirement: horizon market observations reconstructible exactly
requirements.evidence_before: record stores the quote and observed_at but not which capture run confirmed it nor the change-suppression semantics
requirements.evidence_after: market_state on every record: price-change run, snapshot run, series confirmation instant and completeness, last-change observed_at; the close selector reproduces the same two instants independently

requirements.requirement: player context needed for autopsy frozen pregame
requirements.evidence_before: availability state, p_plays, projected volume/share/snap share, QB id, n_prior, shrink; NO injury report, practice status, depth-chart rank, teammate availability, weather, red-zone usage, source timestamps
requirements.evidence_after: player_context frozen per record with UNKNOWN + reason where a source is absent; source timestamps and vintages recorded

requirements.requirement: game context frozen pregame
requirements.evidence_before: spread / total centre and source only
requirements.evidence_after: game_context: implied points, QB ids, rest, division, roof/surface/stadium, weather vintage (or UNKNOWN), market freshness, data freshness

requirements.requirement: data lineage answers 'what did the model know'
requirements.evidence_before: engine/distribution/model versions, data_cutoff, bundle sha; no source versions, no identity-map version, no semantics version, no nflverse retrieval timestamps
requirements.evidence_after: lineage block: nflverse manifest (retrieved_at, sha256 per table), player-map sha, discovery run, capture run, semantics + catalog versions

requirements.requirement: multiple CLV concepts with one documented sign convention
requirements.evidence_before: n/a
requirements.evidence_after: clv.py concepts A-G; POSITIVE = market moved toward the side the model would have bought; pinned by tests; stated in every report

requirements.requirement: close provenance and quality tiers
requirements.evidence_before: n/a
requirements.evidence_after: close record with close_id, source run, confirmation instant, exact age, tier EXCELLENT/GOOD/STALE/MISSING, one-sided and incomplete flags

requirements.requirement: small-edge disagreement bands
requirements.evidence_before: n/a
requirements.evidence_after: bands 0-0.5 / 0.5-1 / 1-2 / 2-3 / 3-5 / 5-10 / >10 pp in scorecard v3 with n, Brier diff, movement, CLV, ROI, width, liquidity

requirements.requirement: status terminology cannot mislead
requirements.evidence_before: PROJECTED stage vs HAS_PROBABILITY counts differ in the report
requirements.evidence_after: flags dict on records; board summary reports HAS_PROBABILITY separately from PROJECTED_ON_SNAPSHOT; docs define each flag

requirements.requirement: research export one row per projection joined to everything
requirements.evidence_before: n/a
requirements.evidence_after: research_export_v2.py rebuilds a deterministic table (jsonl.gz + parquet) from the immutable corpora

requirements.requirement: weekly report + coverage health
requirements.evidence_before: run summary only
requirements.evidence_after: weekly_report_v2.py: coverage, horizon health, model vs market / close, CLV, autopsy, hypothesis-generating exploration, data quality; health gate percentages

requirements.requirement: hypothesis registry with evidence separation
requirements.evidence_before: research/hypothesis_registry/ holds legacy JSON hypotheses; no append-only v2 registry, no status machine, no generation-window guard
requirements.evidence_after: hypothesis_registry_v2.py append-only jsonl with GENERATED..RETIRED statuses; a hypothesis cannot be confirmed on the window that generated it (tested)

requirements.requirement: no hindsight proven adversarially
requirements.evidence_before: post-kickoff, generation-after-kickoff, feature leakage and evidence-class tests exist; nothing on close/settlement entering predictions or later ladders/injuries altering earlier records
requirements.evidence_after: tests: close and settlement never enter records; later ladder cannot alter earlier market distribution; later injury state cannot alter earlier context; immutable records unchanged by later horizons; Week 1 not in the training window

requirements.requirement: close edge cases fail closed
requirements.evidence_before: n/a
requirements.evidence_after: tests: vanished market, early close, one-sided book, no bid/ask, huge spread, incomplete series, relisted ticker, settled pre-game, postponed / moved kickoff, duplicate captures, capture at kickoff

requirements.requirement: performance measured per component
requirements.evidence_before: projector runtime / RSS / bytes only
requirements.evidence_after: pairing, settlement, export and report runtimes and RSS recorded in their summaries; artifact growth per snapshot reported

requirements.requirement: season settlement path exists for every probability written today
requirements.evidence_before: TEAM_WINS_BY_WEEK / DIVISION_WINNER / MAKE_PLAYOFFS carried probabilities with catalog settlement PLANNED
requirements.evidence_after: three deterministic branches, each fail-closed; no branch can be reached before its evidence exists; the NFL tie-break procedure is never reproduced, the league's own bracket output is read instead

requirements.requirement: exchange settlement cross-check
requirements.evidence_before: v2 settlement was nflverse-only; a wrong reading of a contract would settle confidently and wrongly with nothing to notice
requirements.evidence_after: nfl_edge/settlement/crosscheck.py compares every settled row against Kalshi's own terminal resolution read from the daily discovery's settled bucket and the historical backfill (no API calls); provenance, timestamps and both answers preserved; disagreement is a hard warning and is never allowed to substitute for a failed football settlement

requirements.requirement: per-run open-set evidence (was this contract open at this moment)
requirements.evidence_before: state.last_seen gives only the LAST run a ticker was open; absence at any earlier run was unanswerable, so a delisting and a half-failed series fetch were indistinguishable after the fact
requirements.evidence_after: nfl_edge/evaluation/openset.py writes a delta-encoded open set per capture run with a set hash and periodic anchors; six distinct states (OPEN / CLOSED / DELISTED / NOT_RETURNED_DUE_PARTIAL_FETCH / SERIES_NOT_POLLED / UNKNOWN) of which only three are statements about the market; replay verified against the recorded hashes

requirements.requirement: canonical close explains why nothing came after it
requirements.evidence_before: close-2.0.0 selected the last complete valid pre-kickoff observation but could not say why later observations were absent
requirements.evidence_after: close-2.1.0 keeps the selection rule unchanged and adds the presence record at the confirming run plus the disappearance classification; DELISTED_BEFORE_KICKOFF / CLOSED_BEFORE_KICKOFF / ABSENCE_UNEXPLAINED flags; a confirmation is never claimed at a run the open set says the ticker was not open in (CONFIRMATION_RETREATED)

requirements.requirement: top-of-book CLV kept pure
requirements.evidence_before: one pinned sign convention, fee applied once
requirements.evidence_after: unchanged by this round and pinned by test: the depth module may not define or overwrite any canonical CLV field; size-adjusted execution lives in its own block

requirements.requirement: order-book depth preserved at the horizons
requirements.evidence_before: v2 recorded only has_book as a boolean; the full ladder in nfl_edge/execution/depth.py was wired to the v1 path only
requirements.evidence_after: depth is now an INDEPENDENT evidence stream (.github/workflows/shadow-v2-depth.yml, own concurrency group, cancel-in-progress, 40-minute timeout) and is off the horizon freeze's critical path. Per-row honest timing: observed_at, kickoff_utc, minutes_to_kickoff recomputed from that observation, target horizon and actual horizon quality are separate fields. A ladder is entered only if the whole ladder can finish before its own kickoff; a response arriving at or after kickoff is rejected, never written as pregame. Research pairing (nfl_edge/evaluation/execution_depth.DepthIndex) selects the latest observation at or before the projection's cutoff AND strictly before kickoff, so the target label is no longer load-bearing -- the pairing age is. 100% T-30 coverage of a clustered Sunday is NOT claimed: see the rehearsal.

requirements.requirement: size / slippage research from captured depth
requirements.evidence_before: no size-adjusted execution anywhere in v2
requirements.evidence_after: nfl_edge/evaluation/execution_depth.py walks the real ladder for 1/5/10/25/50/100 contracts with the exchange's own per-fill fee carried across the order; partial fills reported as partial; NO BOOK means no number, never an extrapolation of the top level

requirements.requirement: depth selection bias is measured, not assumed away
requirements.evidence_before: not considered
requirements.evidence_after: the capture priority is a function of market properties only (kickoff proximity, whole ladders, traded) and never of the model's own disagreement; coverage is reported by disagreement band so any residual gradient is visible. The first measurement found one: 25.3% coverage at 0-0.5pp disagreement falling to 8.8% above 10pp

requirements.requirement: official gameday inactive state frozen
requirements.evidence_before: INACTIVE_CONFIRMED was reserved and never populated; the repo deliberately refused to build a collector that could degrade to 'everyone is playing'
requirements.evidence_after: nfl_edge/shadow_v2/inactives.py can only ever ADD a confirmed-inactive player: no code path emits an active state (pinned by test), a team block with an implausible count is UNUSABLE rather than half-true, an outage yields zero rows, and an observation after kickoff is POSTGAME_OBSERVATION and freezes nothing. Research only; not wired to the availability gate

requirements.requirement: availability change events between horizons
requirements.evidence_before: raw states were frozen per horizon; the transitions were never derived
requirements.evidence_after: nfl_edge/evaluation/availability_events.py derives transitions from the frozen records (never captured separately, so it cannot contradict them), ranks direction by severity, keeps both raw states on every event, and labels a source going quiet EVIDENCE_LOST rather than a downgrade

requirements.requirement: availability context validated against real captured evidence
requirements.evidence_before: 0% locally; the real context captures live on main's market-data branch and had never been ingested by branch code
requirements.evidence_after: read-only replay against origin/market-data (10,819 files): availability 89.7% known on player rows, with EXPECTED_ACTIVE / OUT / QUESTIONABLE / UNKNOWN distinguished; the content-addressed dedupe of the context captures parses correctly

requirements.requirement: weather context validated against real captured evidence
requirements.evidence_before: 0% locally
requirements.evidence_after: replay: weather state known on 100% of player rows; wind and temperature present on 82.2% of the rows where they can apply, with domes and closed roofs classified NOT_APPLICABLE rather than missing. Forecast issue time and observation time are both preserved, so no actual game weather can ever be attached to an old prediction

requirements.requirement: trade-tape context validated against real captured evidence
requirements.evidence_before: 0% locally
requirements.evidence_after: replay: last-trade recency known on 57.3% of rows, which is the real coverage of a volume-gated tape, not a parse failure. The captured tape carries taker_side / taker_book_side / taker_outcome_side / is_block_trade, so directional pressure is genuinely supported by the exchange data rather than inferred

requirements.requirement: route participation
requirements.evidence_before: recorded as UNKNOWN with the reason 'routes are not in free data; snap share is the only proxy' -- which was wrong about this repo
requirements.evidence_after: real routes exist for 2016-2025 from nflverse pbp_participation (the eleven offensive players on the field per play) and were already built into research/opportunity/player_usage.parquet, 102,422 player-games; v2 simply never attached them. Now frozen as point-in-time route share and targets per route run: 95.3% known on player rows

requirements.requirement: red-zone and goal-line usage
requirements.evidence_before: recorded as UNKNOWN with the reason 'red-zone usage feature not built'
requirements.evidence_after: red-zone target share, red-zone carry share and inside-5 carry share from the play-by-play's own yardline, point-in-time over strictly prior games: 95.3% known on player rows

requirements.requirement: field-by-field context coverage, no headline hiding a gap
requirements.evidence_before: coverage was reported as a few aggregate percentages
requirements.evidence_after: nfl_edge/evaluation/coverage.py reports every field as KNOWN / UNKNOWN / NOT_APPLICABLE with per-field rules. It immediately exposed one the aggregate had hidden: injury_report_status is 0% known because only 275 of 6,419 player rows are on a published report at all, which the 95.6% 'injury state known' headline concealed

requirements.requirement: execution context on every research observation
requirements.evidence_before: bid/ask/mid/width/volume/open interest/fees were present; depth, top-level size and size-adjusted execution were not
requirements.evidence_after: the research row carries the quote, the book shape, the size-adjusted walk and the reason when depth is absent, with prediction research and execution research kept in separate blocks

requirements.requirement: point-in-time source contract, centralised and enforced
requirements.evidence_before: the rule was implemented per source and diverged: four unbounded loaders next to four correct ones
requirements.evidence_after: nfl_edge/shadow_v2/pit.py is the single authority: pick_at_or_before replaces every sorted(glob())[-1], a VintageLedger records every source's vintage and is frozen onto each record's lineage, and three invariants apply at the granularity each belongs to -- a source after the wall clock fails the run, a source at or after a game's kickoff refuses that game's records, and skew short of kickoff is recorded as the record's information_frontier. 19 adversarial tests plant future files that would change the answer.

requirements.requirement: availability hindsight leak
requirements.evidence_before: project_slate_v2 took sorted(glob(...))[-1] for Sleeper/ESPN with no cutoff, feeding p_plays into the priced contract value on all three player arms
requirements.evidence_after: bounded by pit.newest_file_at_or_before against the snapshot; recorded in the ledger; tested with a future availability file present on disk.

requirements.requirement: target-season silver hindsight
requirements.evidence_before: results, closing spread/total lines and finalised QB ids were read unbounded for the target season
requirements.evidence_after: mask_target_season blanks outcome fields for every game not yet kicked off, blanks closing lines for ALL target-season games (a closing line is never point-in-time, so the consensus fallback refuses rather than using it), and blanks QB ids for future games. Measured cost, reported honestly: probability-carrying records fall from 18,226 to 16,160 because games with no Kalshi-implied line no longer borrow a closing line. That is the hindsight being removed, not coverage being lost.

requirements.requirement: quote and book loaders bounded on both axes
requirements.evidence_before: quotes filtered files never rows and nothing at all on the default path; the book loader's docstring claimed row-level bounding it did not implement
requirements.evidence_after: both bounded by run id AND by each row's own observed_at; a row without an instant is refused; books additionally reject any row observed at or after its game's kickoff, which defends against the measured corpus defect (646 of 677,253 pregame book rows were fetched post-kickoff).

requirements.requirement: no probability record silently leaves the evaluation loop
requirements.evidence_before: the settle driver bucketed by game_id and dropped every season record before dispatch
requirements.evidence_after: the driver partitions into game-scoped, season-scoped and an explicitly unreachable remainder and reports silently_dropped: 0; season rows with no kickoff receive CLOSE_NOT_APPLICABLE_SEASON (1,628 on the replay) rather than vanishing from close pairing, and no fake kickoff is invented.

requirements.requirement: injury-report maturity frozen
requirements.evidence_before: every player absent from the parquet was recorded NOT_LISTED, conflating an unpublished report with a clean bill of health; the coverage audit then counted those as NOT_APPLICABLE
requirements.evidence_after: per-week rows and teams are measured and frozen with the vintage, and the states are honest: LISTED / NOT_LISTED_AT_THIS_VINTAGE / REPORT_NOT_AVAILABLE / SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, each carrying report maturity. nflverse rebuilds the file in place, so the counts are captured now or lost.

requirements.requirement: official inactives wired to the frozen context
requirements.evidence_before: InactivesBook existed but was instantiated nowhere, so official_inactive_state was structurally always null
requirements.evidence_after: loaded per run bounded twice (observation at or before the cutoff AND strictly before kickoff) and exposed on the compact player context; ACTIVE is still never inferred from absence.

requirements.requirement: cross-check joins the row it invalidates
requirements.evidence_before: joined on ticker with prediction_id reattached by positional zip after a filtered loop, and no crosscheck column reached the research table
requirements.evidence_after: crosscheck_rows carries prediction_id from the row itself and returns one row per input; the research table exports crosscheck_agreement, hard_warning, exchange result/payout and reason so a disagreeing family can be excluded directly.

requirements.requirement: execution export and autopsy denominator
requirements.evidence_before: execution_research read mid/yes_ask/no_ask which do not exist on a research row; autopsy covered ~1 row in 12 while summaries implied full coverage
requirements.evidence_after: the export reads h_mid/h_yes_ask/h_no_ask; one autopsy per eligible DATA_PLAYER_DIST prediction at every horizon, keyed by prediction_id, with the denominator stated on every row. MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is deliberately excluded: a causal diagnosis of a ladder-implied price would be manufactured.

requirements.requirement: availability-event identity
requirements.evidence_before: events were keyed to an arbitrary (ticker, arm) record, so joining back labelled one row and left siblings blank
requirements.evidence_after: content-addressed event_id over player, game and both context snapshots, plus a join_key on (player, game, horizon pair) that matches every sibling row.

instrumentation_commits: round 2: season settlement, exchange cross-check, open-set evidence, depth + size research, inactives, availability events, route/red-zone, coverage audit

close_pairing_SF_at_LA_pregame_snapshot_.evidence_class: HISTORICAL_RESEARCH (validation of the pipeline only; never prospective evidence)

completeness_rule: A dimension is COMPLETE when the system captures the value wherever it is genuinely available, preserves UNKNOWN explicitly with a reason wherever it is not, and makes absence impossible to mistake for healthy data. A field that is often UNKNOWN can therefore be COMPLETE; a field that is usually present but silently empty when its source fails cannot be.
correction_notice: The round-2 claim 'zero probability records without a settlement path' was FALSE and is withdrawn. It was computed from flags.settlement_supported, which reflected the family CATALOG rather than whether a record could reach a settlement branch; editing the catalog flipped the flag on 1,336 season records that the settlement driver dropped before dispatch. Settlement coverage is now measured by nfl_edge/settlement/reachability.py on the record's own keys, and the measured figure on the real board is 16,114 of 16,160 probability-carrying records dispatchable (99.72%); the remaining 46 are PLAYER_STAT rows with an unresolved subject_id and carry an explicit MISSING_SETTLEMENT_KEYS state.
